title: tab/state
description: Engine-to-shell notification: the tab's address, title, favicon, loading state, history or status text changed (CEF's display and load handlers). Members not present did not change. The Web Browser window's tab strip, address bar and Back and Forward buttons follow these.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

title.description: The page's title (OnTitleChange); the url while it has none.

favicon.description: The page's icon as a `data:image/png;base64,...` url, at most 32 by 32 pixels (OnFaviconURLChange, then CefBrowserHost::DownloadImage of the first icon); empty when the page has none.

canGoBack.description: The tab's history has an entry before the current one (OnLoadingStateChange).

statusText.description: The status text (a link's url under the pointer; OnStatusMessage); empty to clear.
